evals.prompt: Here is my recording of my one-on-one with my manager this morning, ~/Movies/recs/2026-09-10 10-02-11.mkv. We talked about feedback on two teammates. Can you transcribe it?
evals.expected_output: Routes to transcript-only mode in Phase 0. Writes .txt/.srt to a transcripts folder outside git and outside any vault after check_private_dest.sh prints SAFE. Creates no meeting folder, no knowledge extraction, no decisions log entry, no Bibliotheque entry, no Jira ticket, and no git add.
expectations: Claude classifies the recording as private (one-on-one with interpersonal feedback) before any ingest step
Claude runs scripts/check_private_dest.sh on the output directory before writing the transcript
No file is created under general/meetings/ and no knowledge/ or topics/ files are written
No Jira, Bibliotheque inbox, DECISIONS_LOG or weekly-note write happens, and no git add or commit runs
Claude stops after reporting the transcript paths and does not extract action items

evals.prompt: Transcribe ~/Movies/recs/call.mkv but just the transcript, no notes please.
evals.expected_output: Transcript-only mode is selected from the explicit 'just the transcript, no notes' cue. Transcription follows references/recording-recovery.md (normalize, whisper-cli, repeat-loop check). Pipeline stops after the transcript.
expectations: Claude selects transcript-only mode because the user asked for just the transcript
The transcription uses normalized 16 kHz mono audio and whisper-cli with the large-v3-turbo model
Claude checks the transcript for runs of identical consecutive lines (repeat-loop hallucination)
No meeting summary, ticket candidates or knowledge library are produced

evals.prompt: I have a recording of today's sprint planning with the whole team at ~/Movies/klever/planning.mkv. Process this meeting and propose tickets.
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 routes this as a project meeting and the normal pipeline runs. The media file path is recorded but the video is not copied into raw/ or git.
expectations: Claude routes the recording as a project meeting and continues to Phase 1 Ingest
Claude does not copy the .mkv file into the meeting folder raw/ directory
Claude stops at the user gate after Synthesize before creating any Jira ticket

evals.expected_output: The context does not say whether the recording is a project meeting or private. Claude asks the user before choosing the full pipeline.
expectations: Claude asks whether the recording is a project meeting or a private conversation before writing any meeting folder or notes
Claude does not create general/meetings/ files before the user answers
